item.title: Version 0.17.1
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.17.1

What’s New

  • Close Tabs in Compact Mode: Right-click any live tab in compact mode to close it directly from the context menu.
  • Copy AI Chat Messages: Hover over any message in Ask AI to reveal a copy button for quick clipboard access.

Bug Fixes

  • Command Panel Paste: Fixed URL paste from clipboard triggering the scope picker instead of navigating.
  • AI Agent Persistence: The AI agent no longer terminates when the command panel is closed mid-conversation.
  • Space Navigation Toggle: Changing the space navigation shortcut now takes effect immediately without restarting.
  • Save Tabs on Space Switch: Fixed the “Save Tabs on Space Switch” setting being silently re-enabled after turning it off.
